onboarding.title: Demo step
onboarding.description: Four quick steps to open the demo recipes.

notice.title: Accept the notice
notice.description: Ultra Hero recipes are demo content.
notice.item1: There is no review by a dietitian or any other health professional.
notice.item2: Recipes don't replace professional advice or treat health conditions.
notice.item3: Always check the ingredients, especially if you have an allergy or restriction.
notice.accept: I have read and accept the notice

diet.title: Restrictions and allergies
diet.description: Mark what applies to you. If nothing applies, just continue.
diet.privacy: We only use this to remind you on each recipe page. You can change or delete it anytime.

interests.title: Your interests
interests.description: Pick the topics that suit you best.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Review your choices before opening the recipes.

errors.invalid: Check your choices and try again.

library.endorsementNote: {hero} recommends these recipes. Each one is signed by the chef who created it.

reminder.title: Check the ingredients
reminder.description: You told us: {items}. This recipe has no professional review; check every ingredient before cooking.

legacyEditor.title: Read-only recipe
legacyEditor.description: Recipe editing comes back with the new editor. Until then, this recipe stays as it is and remains live as before.
